## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Valle de Banderas, Mexico. It starts at Carretera a Tepic Kilómetro 155.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Prepare for an adventure at Aquaventuras Park. Break a sweat on a huge climbing wall that's roughly three stories high, then cool down with the wind on your face as you zipline through the park and take on the park's fun slides. Make sure to swing by one of the sea lion or dolphin shows before you go!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €19.18. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 19 ratings and 11 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
